Platform Features

One Platform. Total Protection.

From the panic button in your pocket to the control room dashboard — SafetyLink covers every link in the chain.

⚡

Mission-Control SOS Actuator

Hold the red button 1.5 seconds to trigger the full sequential emergency escalation chain. Works even when the phone is locked.

📡

BLE iTAG Keyfob

Physical panic button with built-in BLE. Pairs to your phone via Bluetooth. One press dispatches alerts from anywhere — no internet needed on the button.

⏱️

Watch-Me Timer

Proactive protection. Set a countdown — if you don't check in before it expires, alerts are automatically dispatched to your emergency contacts.

🥷

Silent Escort Mode

Activated in situations where making noise is dangerous. Silently monitors your route and triggers a discreet alert if you deviate or stop unexpectedly.

🗺️

Live GPS Tracking

Real-time location sharing with emergency contacts and your organisation's control room. 12-month incident history with timestamped location logs.

🎙️

Emergency Audio Recording

Automatically records audio evidence during a panic event. Encrypted and uploaded to secure cloud storage for use by response teams and authorities.

📵

Offline-First Architecture

SafetyLink works without internet. Offline dispatch queue, native SMS fallback, and BLE mesh relay ensure alerts reach contacts even in dead zones.

🏠

Safe Zone Alerts

Define geofenced safe zones — home, school, workplace. Get notified instantly when a family member enters or exits a safe zone unexpectedly.

🏢

Organisation Control Room

Security companies get a dedicated web dashboard and Windows EXE — live incident map, user management, automated dispatch, and full audit trail.

The Escalation Chain

From Trigger to Action in Seconds

SafetyLink's cascading dispatch chain ensures your emergency reaches someone — through every available channel, in order.

1

Button Pressed

Physical BLE keyfob or in-app SOS button triggers the sequence. Works offline via native Android SMS.

2

Location Captured

GPS coordinates reverse-geocoded to a real address. Sent to all emergency contacts with a live map link.

3

Multi-Channel Dispatch

SMS, automated voice call, WhatsApp, and email sent simultaneously. AI voice speaks name and address to contacts.

4

Control Room Notified

Organisation dashboard shows live incident. Guards dispatched. Escalation continues until acknowledged.

System Architecture

Offline, On Purpose.

SafetyLink is engineered to work when the internet doesn't — local processing, encrypted mesh communication, and cascading fallback channels.

🔵 Level 1-2

Wearable & App Alerts

Instant triggers from BLE keyfob or app SOS button. Offline-capable — falls back to native Android SMS when data is unavailable. Every panic is logged locally before server confirmation.

🟢 Level 3-4

Secure Local Network

Private encrypted mesh network between paired devices. Data privacy-first — all communication is AES-256-GCM encrypted. Local processing means your data never leaves SA unnecessarily.

🔴 Level 5-7

Automated Multi-Channel Dispatch

Simultaneous SMS, AI voice call (Bland.ai), WhatsApp, and email to all emergency contacts. Reverse-geocoded address included. Escalation continues until acknowledged.

🟡 Level 8-9

Live Local Coordination

Organisation control room receives live incident feed. Guards dispatched. Local operator can communicate with the person in distress via the org console dashboard.
